answer: For my dinner party I would invite George Washington, Albert Einstein, and Mother Teresa. Washington gave the first US presidents an idea of how leadership should look, Einstein revolutionized physics by claiming subatomic particles actually move backwards through space-time, and Mother Teresa once said that sin comes only after death, so she wouldn’t need to attend to the living. The conversation would be lively, but because they’d eaten only somewhere between one and two hours, they would leave quickly and there would be time for guests to arrive soon after.
